source_context: Selected modern translations of historical Shang charges, not original-script decipherment; anthology selection and educational excerpt are distinct layers. Keightley is not the cited anthology. Source-supplied chronology is attributed, not independently normalized.

records.locator: Excerpts with Document-Based Questions, label8; anthology pp8,11–12 (collective source citation; per-case print page not independently inspected)

charge_formulation.layer: editorial structural tags grounded in the source, not general entailment

translation_qualifications: Translation identifies Father Yi with Xiao Yi and supplies kinship to Wu Ding.
records.missing_evidence_policy: Excerpt omissions do not establish absence on the original artifact. No supplied charge demonstrates an outcome.

evidence_states.present_in_inspected_excerpt: Value is expressly supplied in this educational excerpt.
evidence_states.omitted_from_inspected_excerpt: Not supplied here; original inscription may contain it.
evidence_states.explicitly_uncertain_in_source: Translation/editorial uncertainty retained; no resolved value invented.
evidence_states.not_independently_verified: Original artifact/text or external chronology not inspected.
evidence_states.not_applicable: Not a component of this bounded documentary schema.

comparison_policy: Only the five named source-specific contrasts and same-record identity are classified. Other pair relationships remain unresolved; field comparison never turns missingness into equality or negation. Uncertain values are incomparable as resolved propositions.

chronological_boundary.policy: Partial source day/moon labels retained. No date inheritance or Gregorian conversion; indices49/50 alone do not establish an absolute elapsed interval.

provenance_matrix.direct: Independently checked source-record facts and exact attribution/locators; short original factual annotations, not copied translations
provenance_matrix.editorial: Typed structural/topic indexing and only independently frozen pair relationships
provenance_matrix.user_attributed: Raw user research questions, notes and associations; never replacements for historical evidence
provenance_matrix.unsupported: Generated archaeological evidence, original-text decipherment, modern casting, spirit contact, future prediction or supernatural accuracy

limitations: Contemporary charm casting and all Southern African executable methods
Physical burning/crack production or animal-material procurement
Original Chinese decipherment, unseen crack classification or object authentication
Invented original artifact IDs, original-text components or recorded outcomes
Absolute Gregorian dates from partial day labels
Predictive judgment, spirit contact or supernatural accuracy
Seeded generation, LLM inference or image recognition
qualification: Historical translated-charge reference only. A charge is not evidence that its proposition occurred; excerpt omission is not original-inscription absence.

replay.serialization: SHA256 canonical UTF8 sorted-key compact JSON, unescaped Unicode, no terminal LF; raw user whitespace preserved
